svg.title: VRC support across the pipeline
svg.desc: Matrix: for each layer (layout and graphs, task planning, motion planning, action graph, dispatch and safety) what VRC code exists, what of it runs on a normal plan call, what is missing or risky, and a yes / partial / no status. Pecos has no VRC.
